# Workflow jobs that legitimately run in BOTH nginx/nginx-gateway-fabric and
# the internal release mirror.
# Format: <workflow file>:<job id>. Blank lines and # comments are ignored.
# Bar for a line here: safe on an unreleased branch (no registry/tag/release/
# chart publish); must NOT also carry a gate or appear in job-gating-baseline.txt.

# ci.yml -- the cheap checks that catch a broken cherry-pick.
.github/workflows/ci.yml:vars
.github/workflows/ci.yml:unit-tests
.github/workflows/ci.yml:njs-unit-tests
.github/workflows/ci.yml:rust-unit-tests
.github/workflows/ci.yml:cel-tests

# dependency-review.yml -- a pull request check that writes nothing.
.github/workflows/dependency-review.yml:dependency-review

# release-pr.yml -- opens the release pull request. Runs in the mirror, where
# the release is prepared, against internal/release-X.Y; it publishes nothing.
.github/workflows/release-pr.yml:release

# The cluster suites a release validates with. A release runs them from the
# mirror against the images prep staged; they publish nothing. Where one opens
# a results pull request, that job stays gated to the public repository.
# Their schedules stay public-only, suppressed by event in each workflow.
.github/workflows/longevity-start.yml:vars
.github/workflows/longevity-start.yml:setup-and-run-tests
.github/workflows/longevity-stop.yml:vars
.github/workflows/longevity-stop.yml:teardown-tests
.github/workflows/nfr.yml:vars
.github/workflows/nfr.yml:setup-and-run-tests
.github/workflows/gatewaylink.yml:vars
.github/workflows/gatewaylink.yml:setup-and-run-tests

# lint.yml -- static analysis only. No job here can reach a registry.
.github/workflows/lint.yml:lint
.github/workflows/lint.yml:njs-lint
.github/workflows/lint.yml:rust-lint
.github/workflows/lint.yml:actionlint
.github/workflows/lint.yml:release-scripts
.github/workflows/lint.yml:gating
.github/workflows/lint.yml:markdown-lint
.github/workflows/lint.yml:chart-lint
.github/workflows/lint.yml:yaml-lint
